title: Inline title edit
description: Keep a document’s identity in place while editing, committing, or cancelling.
useCase: Keep a document’s identity in place while editing, committing, or cancelling.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Local state only; no document is renamed outside the demo.
look: Light grey page with a white rounded card: a tilted pale-green document icon, small grey label, dark sans-serif title with pencil glyph, sage caption.
motion: Clicking the title swaps in a pre-selected text field while the action buttons fade down 3 px into place over 140 ms ease-out; saving swaps back and shows a confirmation.
adapt: `editing` swaps the `title` button for the form; the effect focuses and selects the input, then returns focus to `titleButton`. The only animation is `sf-editable-document-title-editIn` on `edit-actions`; replace the collection label, count and `title`, and persist in `commit`.
